entries.title: Website sign-ins moved to Settings → Secrets
entries.body: The website sign-ins you save as you hand a task's browser back are now listed at the end of Settings → Secrets, beside the other things your crew uses without seeing. They still stay on this computer in their own storage, and Remove and each site's permission for future tasks work as before. Manage on a task's browser opens them there. Where Secrets is not offered, they stay in Settings → General.

picture.alt: Settings → Secrets ending with Website sign-ins after Keep a copy: two saved sites, each with Remove and a permission for future tasks
